live.pageSubtitle: Record several broadcasts at once. Each one keeps its own connection, statistics and viewer ranking; switching tabs never stops another recording.

tabs.newTitle: Start another recording without stopping the current ones
tabs.hint: Tabs only switch the view; they never stop another broadcast. Stop a recording before closing its tab.
tabs.closeHint: Only ended tabs can be closed; their data is already in History.

new.title: New recording
new.subtitleIdle: Connect to a live Bilibili or YouTube broadcast, or try the simulator to see how recording works.
new.subtitleRunning: {n} broadcast(s) keep recording in the background. Starting a new one will not stop them.
new.background: {n} broadcast(s) are still recording in the background. Open their tabs at any time.

hero.idleSubtitle: Start a simulated stream to see how LiveMemory records chat, gifts and viewers — or connect to a Bilibili or YouTube broadcast that is live right now.
hero.stopHint: Only this broadcast stops. Other tabs keep recording.
hero.endedNotice: This recording has ended and is saved in live history.
hero.failedNotice: This broadcast's connection was lost. Other recordings are unaffected and received data is saved.
hero.startFailed: The simulated stream could not start.

chart.title: Message density
chart.hint: Bucket size adapts to the session length
chart.empty: The chart appears as soon as messages arrive.

feed.title: Recent activity
feed.empty: Messages, gifts and Super Chats will appear here.

top.title: Most active viewers
top.hint: Top 100 this session · by valid messages

source.title: Live source
source.hint: The simulator lets you try the recording flow; Bilibili and YouTube connect to real live broadcasts (live only).
source.mockNote: Simulated events only verify the recording flow; they are not real platform data.
source.loginAnonymous: Not signed in (public chat works anonymously)
source.loginExpired: The QR code expired. Open the sign-in page again
source.anonymousNote: Public chat, gifts and Super Chats work without signing in. Signing in does not change viewer identity fields.
source.moneyNote: Amounts follow the platform: gifts at 1000 gold coins = ¥1, Super Chats quoted in yuan, and guard prices stay unbooked because their unit is unconfirmed.
source.identityNote: Viewer identity uses the platform UID. Nicknames may be masked by the platform (e.g. “电***”); they are never guessed or merged.
source.loginScanHint: Scan the QR code below with the Bilibili mobile app and confirm on your phone. The code is generated locally; no external page is opened.
source.loginQrUnavailable: Could not render the QR code. Reload the page and try again.
source.youtubeIntro: Paste the link of a YouTube broadcast that is live right now, or its video ID. Only live broadcasts are supported — uploaded videos and comments are never fetched.
source.youtubeUnavailable: YouTube live chat is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
source.youtubePolicyBody: YouTube public chat is platform data. Chat text, emote/badge metadata and stale nicknames are kept for at most {days} days by default; message counts, stable channel ids and support totals remain.
source.youtubeAutoEnded: The broadcast ended. The recording is saved
source.youtubeIdentityNote: The public web chat normally provides a real Channel ID. If a message lacks one, LiveMemory never invents identity from a nickname.
source.youtubeMoneyNote: Super Chat only exposes a formatted amount string (for example HK$2,000.00). LiveMemory converts it only when the currency is confirmable; otherwise the amount stays unknown and the raw display text is kept.

history.pageSubtitle: Every recorded broadcast, with local statistics that do not depend on any AI service.
history.emptyBody: Start a recording on the Live page. Finished sessions are kept here with their statistics and timeline.

detail.supportEmpty: No paid events in this session.
detail.aiPendingBody: Export an AI analysis package and give it to any AI service to add topics, sentiment shifts and clip suggestions.
detail.simulatedNote: This session contains simulated data used to verify the recording pipeline.
detail.interruptedNote: This session was interrupted (the app closed unexpectedly). Its statistics are kept as recorded.
detail.deletedBody: This session was deleted. It no longer exists in history, search or viewer participation records.
detail.archivedBody: Archived sessions are hidden from the default history list but remain searchable, openable and exportable. Unarchive it from the ··· menu.
detail.stoppedBody: Local capture ended here. The platform broadcast may have continued; this is not a platform 'stream ended' event.
detail.viewerHint: Only messages with this stable platform identity are shown. Anonymous messages cannot be attributed to a viewer.
detail.viewerMissing: This viewer has no recorded participation in this session.
detail.viewerNoText: The message text for this session is no longer stored (compact mode or retention). Counts and identity remain.
detail.viewerNoMessages: No chat messages from this viewer in this session.
detail.aiReportBody: Imported AI analysis for this broadcast. AI output is separate from local statistics.

search.placeholder: Search by broadcaster, title or viewer
search.label: Search live history
search.identityHint: Anonymous messages without a stable platform ID cannot be found by viewer. Identities with the same nickname are listed separately and never merged.
search.noResultsBody: Try a different term or relax the platform, status, date and archive filters.

stop.title: Stop this recording?
stop.subtitle: Only this session stops; other recordings keep running.
stop.noteTitle: The broadcast may still be live
stop.note: Stopping ends local capture and keeps every collected message, viewer identity, statistic and support record. It does not tell Bilibili or YouTube that the broadcast has ended.

delete.title: Permanently delete this session?
delete.subtitle: This cannot be undone. There is no recycle bin.
delete.deletesBody: Messages, events, economic support, session statistics, viewer participation, AI analysis packages and their exported files for this session only.
delete.keepsBody: Viewers who also appear in other sessions, their profiles for other broadcasters, every other session, settings and login data. Viewers whose only record was this session are removed.
delete.ackTitle: I understand this cannot be undone
delete.ackBody: This record and the data that belongs only to it will be removed from this computer.

viewers.pageSubtitle: Long-term profiles built from stable platform identities. Nickname changes never split a person in two.
viewers.emptyBody: Viewers appear here once they speak or send support during a recorded session.

scope.label: Broadcaster scope
scope.scopedHint: These numbers only include this broadcaster's sessions.
scope.unassignedTitle: Some history has no confirmed broadcaster
scope.unassignedBody: {sessions} sessions could not be attributed to a broadcaster and include {viewers} viewers. The records are kept and marked unassigned; nothing was guessed.

detail.scopeHint: Showing {name}. All statistics, support and sessions are limited to this broadcaster.
detail.allScopeHint: Showing the global totals across every broadcaster. Select one broadcaster for its separate profile.
detail.globalHint: Global totals span every recorded broadcaster and are for overview only; they are never mixed into the selected broadcaster's profile.
detail.interestsEmpty: Interests are added by an imported AI profile update (milestone M7). Until then only local facts are shown.
detail.notes: LiveMemory shows facts it recorded. How you use them is entirely your decision.

ai.pageSubtitle: Manual file round trip with any AI service: no API keys, no cloud account, no automatic model calls.

steps.exportDesc: Build versioned .zip packages (one per message batch) with chat, aggregates, emote names, AI instructions and the result schema.
steps.promptDesc: Upload the package and send the AI analysis instructions.
steps.importDesc: Validate the JSON, confirm, and read the reproducible analysis report.

export.title: Export AI analysis package
export.hint: The archive contains the chat log, session statistics, viewer context, the platform emote dictionary, the localized AI instructions and the JSON schema. No cookies or tokens are included.
export.empty: Record a session first — there is nothing to analyse yet.

prompt.title: AI analysis instructions
prompt.hint: The same text is inside the package as instructions.md.

import.title: Import the AI answer
import.body: Choose the JSON file the AI produced, or paste its JSON text. Nothing is saved until validation passes and you confirm.
import.pastePlaceholder: Paste the complete JSON object returned by the AI service.
import.alreadyImported: This exact result was already imported as version {version}.
import.duplicateBody: This answer is identical to result version {version}. Nothing was written.
import.versionBody: A different result already exists for this task/batch (latest version {version}). Importing adds version {next} and keeps the old one.
import.errorsHint: Nothing has been saved. Fix the fields below in the JSON and validate again.
import.successBody: Saved as version {version}. The report below is based only on this validated AI result.
import.fileTooLarge: That file is larger than the {limit} MB import limit.

reason.INVALID_JSON: The text is not valid JSON. A trailing comma or missing quote is the usual cause.
reason.NOT_OBJECT: The top-level value must be a JSON object, not an array or primitive.
reason.TOO_LARGE: The answer is larger than the import limit.
reason.TOO_COMPLEX: The JSON has too many nodes to validate safely.
reason.TOO_DEEP: The JSON is nested too deeply.
reason.STRING_TOO_LONG: A text value is longer than allowed.
reason.FORBIDDEN_KEY: The JSON contains a field name that is not allowed.
reason.SCHEMA_CONST: The value does not match the required constant.
reason.SCHEMA_ENUM: The value is not one of the allowed options.
reason.SCHEMA_TYPE: The value has the wrong JSON type.
reason.SCHEMA_UNKNOWN_FIELD: This field is not part of the result schema.
reason.SCHEMA_MIN_LENGTH: The text is shorter than allowed.
reason.SCHEMA_MAX_LENGTH: The text is longer than allowed.
reason.SCHEMA_DATETIME: The timestamp is not a valid ISO-8601 date-time with a timezone.
reason.SCHEMA_MINIMUM: The number is below the allowed minimum.
reason.SCHEMA_MAXIMUM: The number is above the allowed maximum.
reason.SCHEMA_MIN_ITEMS: The array has too few items.
reason.SCHEMA_MAX_ITEMS: The array has too many items.
reason.SCHEMA_REF_SHAPE: A message reference must be a positive seq number or an object {batch, seq}.
reason.SCHEMA_AMBIGUOUS: A value matches more than one allowed shape.
reason.PROTOCOL_MISMATCH: This is not a LiveMemory analysis result (wrong protocol).
reason.SCHEMA_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED: This LiveMemory version does not support that result schema version.
reason.SESSION_NOT_FOUND: That broadcast does not exist in this LiveMemory data folder.
reason.SESSION_MISMATCH: The answer belongs to a different broadcast than the analysis task.
reason.SESSION_EMPTY: This broadcast has no messages to analyse.
reason.JOB_NOT_FOUND: The analysis task no longer exists (its data may have been deleted).
reason.TASK_MISMATCH: The task id does not match this task or batch.
reason.BATCH_MISMATCH: The batch id is not part of this analysis task.
reason.BATCH_MISSING: The answer does not say which batch it belongs to.
reason.BATCH_NOT_READY: Not every batch result has been imported yet.
reason.AGGREGATE_NOT_READY: Not every batch result has been imported yet, so the aggregate answer cannot be accepted.
reason.REF_AMBIGUOUS: A plain seq is ambiguous in an aggregate result; use {batch, seq}.
reason.REF_OTHER_BATCH: The reference points to a different batch than this answer.
reason.MESSAGE_REF_UNKNOWN: The cited message seq does not exist in this package or batch.
reason.VIEWER_UNKNOWN: That viewer id is not in this batch’s viewer context.
reason.VIEWER_DUPLICATE: The same viewer id appears more than once.
reason.BROADCASTER_MISMATCH: The broadcaster id does not match this broadcast.
reason.BROADCASTER_UNVERIFIED: This broadcast has no confirmed broadcaster id, so the value was not used for identity.
reason.TIME_INVALID: The time could not be parsed.
reason.TIME_ORDER: The end time is earlier than the start time.
reason.TIME_OUT_OF_RANGE: The time is outside this broadcast’s recording window.
reason.TIME_OUTSIDE_BATCH: The time is outside this batch’s covered range.
reason.EVIDENCE_TOO_MANY: The answer cites too many messages.
reason.VERSION_CONFIRM_REQUIRED: A different result already exists; confirm a new version explicitly.
reason.RESULT_EMPTY: The answer contains no summary, topic, dispute, highlight or viewer profile.
reason.EVIDENCE_PURGED: A cited message’s text was removed by retention or compact mode; the reference is kept but the original is unavailable.
reason.EVIDENCE_DELETED: A cited message row no longer exists; it is shown as unavailable.
reason.LOCALE_MISMATCH: The answer language differs from the task’s prompt language.
reason.LEGACY_PACKAGE: This answer matches a pre-M6 package; it is still validated and tracked.
reason.BATCH_ID_MISSING: batch_id was absent; the batch was resolved from the task id.

fix.json: Return one valid JSON object, without comments, prose or trailing commas.
fix.size: Reduce the answer to the schema limits, then validate again.
fix.type: Use the exact JSON type declared in result.schema.json.
fix.range: Use a value inside the allowed length, number or array range.
fix.enum: Use one of the allowed enum values exactly as written.
fix.datetime: Use an ISO-8601 timestamp with timezone, for example 2026-11-08T10:00:00.000Z.
fix.unknown_field: Remove the field, or move its content into a documented field.
fix.missing: Add the missing required field exactly as shown in result.schema.json.
fix.version: Use the protocol and schema_version from this package’s result.schema.json.
fix.session: Re-export the package from the correct broadcast in LiveMemory.
fix.task: Copy task_id and job_id verbatim from this package’s manifest.json.
fix.batch: Copy batch_id and task_id verbatim from this package’s manifest.json.
fix.aggregate: Import every batch result first, then create and analyse the aggregate package.
fix.message_ref: Use only seq numbers (or {batch, seq}) that exist in the analysed package.
fix.viewer: Use only viewer_id values from viewer_context.json; never guess or merge by nickname.
fix.broadcast: Copy broadcaster_id from manifest.json, or omit it.

import.noTarget: The answer could not be matched to a broadcast or task.
import.legacyNotice: This answer matches a pre-M6 package. It is linked by session and task id; a task record is created for it.
import.warningsHint: Warnings do not block the import, but the report will mark missing evidence as unavailable.
import.jsonEmpty: Paste JSON text or choose a file first.
import.pasteHint: Large files are fine up to {limit} MB; the answer is never executed.

task.title: What the AI will analyse
task.topics: The topics discussed across the session and how they changed
task.timeline: How discussion shifted over time and which periods were most active
task.highlights: Candidate moments worth rewatching (chat evidence only)
task.newViewers: Viewer profiles for identities with enough evidence
task.existingViewers: New information and interest changes for existing viewers
task.emoji: Text, Unicode emoji and platform emote names; unknown emotes are marked explicitly and never guessed.
task.serviceTitle: Use the AI service you choose
task.serviceBody: LiveMemory is not tied to any AI brand. Any service that accepts file upload and returns structured JSON works. File size, ZIP support and context length differ between services; split batches are provided for long streams.

setup.title: Create an analysis task
setup.batchSizeHint: The package is split at message boundaries. 100–5000 messages per batch; long streams produce several batches.
setup.empty: Record a broadcast first — there is nothing to analyse yet.
setup.note: LiveMemory never calls an AI API. Upload each package to an AI service of your choice, then import the JSON answer here.

jobs.title: Analysis tasks
jobs.empty: No analysis task for this broadcast yet.
jobs.aggregateHint: After every batch result is imported, stage 2 merges them; import its JSON to complete the task.
jobs.reanalyzeHint: Creates a new task with the current prompt. The existing task and its result versions are kept.
jobs.noPackages: Package files are no longer available.

report.title: Live analysis report
report.incompleteBody: Only part of this broadcast has been analysed. The cards below are separate batch results, not a merged report.
report.awaitingAggregate: All batch results are imported. Create and analyse the stage-2 aggregate package to get a session-wide report.
report.sentimentNote: AI estimate from chat text only. Sarcasm, memes and emoji can be ambiguous; low-confidence points are marked.
report.clipNotice: LiveMemory analyses chat and event records only. It did not watch or record the video and cannot create clips; these are candidate time ranges based on chat activity.
report.evidenceUnavailable: The original message is no longer stored.
report.evidencePurged: The original text was removed by retention or compact mode.
report.evidenceMissingCount: {n} cited message(s) are no longer available.
report.viewerProfilesNote: Profiles are AI inferences about viewers in this broadcast only. They are not verified long-term facts and are never merged across broadcasters.
report.partialNote: This is one batch result. It is not a session-wide conclusion.
report.evidenceNote: Only messages that really existed in this broadcast can be cited. Missing originals are shown as unavailable, never reconstructed.
report.noReportBody: Import an AI result for this broadcast to see a report.
report.aggregateRequiredBody: The batch results below are ready. Generate the aggregate package in AI analysis, ask an AI service to merge it, then import the final JSON.

settings.pageSubtitle: Language, appearance and storage. Preferences are saved on this computer and survive restarts.

language.title: Language
language.desc: Used by the web console and by the launcher console window.
language.headerHint: The language control in the page header is the quickest way to switch; both use the same saved preference.
language.note: Chat messages are never translated; AI reports follow the analysis language you choose.

theme.title: Appearance
theme.desc: Light and dark are designed separately for comfortable contrast.
theme.hint: Follow system switches automatically when Windows changes theme.

storage.title: Storage mode
storage.desc: Controls how long raw chat text is kept. Totals and profiles are always kept.
storage.compactDesc: Raw chat is kept until an analysis import is verified, then the text is purged while counts, viewers and payments remain.
storage.fullDesc: Raw chat and events are kept indefinitely so sessions can be re-analysed later.
storage.note: Automatic purging is part of M4/M6; in this build nothing is deleted automatically.

data.title: Your data
data.desc: Everything lives in a folder you own. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
data.backupBody: Portable .livememory backup and restore arrive in milestone M5. Today you can copy the data folder while LiveMemory is closed.

dataLocation.title: Data storage location
dataLocation.desc: LiveMemory keeps its records in the folder below. You can move it to a larger disk or another drive.
dataLocation.recordingBlocked: A broadcast is being recorded. Stop recording before changing the location or clearing data.
dataLocation.note: Migration copies and verifies everything first and switches only after success. The old folder is never deleted automatically.

locationDialog.title: Change data storage location
locationDialog.desc: Choose a Windows folder or enter a complete path. A migration to another disk can take a while.
locationDialog.migrateDesc: Copies live history, chat, viewer profiles, support totals, AI analysis data, settings and local login state. The old folder is left untouched.
locationDialog.newDesc: Copies no live records. Settings and local login state move across; the old folder is left untouched and can be selected again later.
locationDialog.cloudWarning: {provider} sync folders can make SQLite WAL files inconsistent. Prefer a local folder that is not synchronised.
locationDialog.tempWarning: The target is inside a temporary folder that Windows may clean up.
locationDialog.longPathWarning: The path is long and some tools may not be able to access it.
locationDialog.acceptWarnings: I understand these risks and want to continue
locationDialog.migrating: Copying and verifying data. Do not close the window…
locationDialog.resultBody: The new data folder passed verification and is now in use. The old folder is still there and can be removed manually once you are satisfied.

danger.title: Data management
danger.desc: These actions cannot be undone. Create a backup or copy the data folder first.
danger.clearTitle: Clear all live and viewer data
danger.clearDesc: Deletes live sessions, chat, viewer profiles, broadcaster–viewer relations, support totals, AI analysis data and history aggregates from the current data space. Language, appearance, data folder and platform login settings are kept.
danger.factoryDesc: Deletes all personal data in the current data space, including preferences, login credentials, AI analysis and caches, and restores the default language and theme. Unrelated files in the data root and external backups are never deleted.
danger.backupTitle: Create a database snapshot before deleting
danger.backupDesc: Creates a SQLite database snapshot in the folder below (analysis packages and backups are not included). This is not the portable .livememory backup planned for M5.
danger.skipBackupWarning: Without a backup these records cannot be recovered.
danger.recording: A broadcast is being recorded. Stop recording before doing this.
danger.confirmBody: This cannot be undone. Type {word} to confirm.
danger.busy: Clearing data and reinitialising the database…
danger.resultBody: The database was cleared and reinitialised. Sessions, viewers and events are all zero.
danger.resultFactoryBody: Personal data, preferences and login credentials were removed; the app is back to its first-run state.

youtube.title: YouTube integration
youtube.desc: YouTube live chat is read through the web-chat mechanism used by the public live page. No Google login, API key or cookie is required.
youtube.notRequired: No Google login, API key or cookie
youtube.retention: Chat text, emote/badge metadata and stale nicknames are kept for at most 30 days; counts, stable channel ids and support totals remain.
youtube.privacyBody: This mechanism is not a stable API provided by YouTube and may stop working if the page or platform policy changes. LiveMemory does not claim YouTube endorsement and does not guarantee permanent availability.
